summary: On the main deck, Morpheus is in tears as he takes hold of the EMP switch, apparently preparing to trigger it. Trinity, holding Neo's body, whispers in his ear and pleads with him to listen. She recounts that the Oracle told her she would fall in love and that the man she loved would be 'the one.' She insists Neo cannot be dead because she loves him, declaring it twice, then closes her eyes and kisses him, believing wholeheartedly that he will feel her lips and know the truth of her words.

what_changes.before: Grieving and pleading over Neo's seemingly lifeless body, trying to reach him.
what_changes.after: She kisses him, 'believing in all her heart that he will feel her lips and know that they speak the truth,' shifting toward hope and conviction.
what_changes.evidence: Her eyes close and she kisses him, believing in all her heart that he will feel her lips

what_changes.before: Weeping, he is poised to act, taking hold of the EMP switch.
what_changes.after: His intent to trigger the EMP remains unresolved within the scene as Trinity intervenes with Neo.
what_changes.evidence: In tears, Morpheus takes hold of the EMP switch.

event_hint.one_line: Amid the ship's crisis, Trinity makes a desperate, loving appeal to revive the apparently dead Neo.

uncertain: Whether Neo actually responds to Trinity's kiss within this scene.
Whether Morpheus ultimately triggers the EMP switch.
